interconnect_rules.rule: WISHBONE interconnect must have at least one MASTER interface. Also see: SLAVE.
WISHBONE interconnect must have at least one SLAVE. Also see: MASTER.

default_signal_values.ERR_O_when_absent: 0 (LOW) — SLAVE does not implement error termination
default_signal_values.STALL_O_when_absent: 0 (LOW) — slave is not stalled (standard mode SLAVE)
default_signal_values.CTI_O_when_absent: 3'b000 (Classic cycle) — backwards compatibility with non-Registered-Feedback cores (RULE 4.10; PERMISSION 4.10 — VHDL CTI_I default '000')
default_signal_values.BTE_O_when_absent: 2'b00 (Linear burst) — when CTI does not indicate incrementing burst
default_signal_values.SEL_O_when_granularity_eq_portsize: All bits HIGH — the entire bus is selected

id_routing.description: Wishbone B4 does NOT define a Manager-ID concept like AHB5 HMASTER or AXI AxID. In multi-MASTER systems, the INTERCON's arbiter tracks which MASTER won the bus and routes the response back accordingly.
id_routing.implication: Wishbone is inherently single-outstanding per MASTER (Classic) or in-order per MASTER (pipelined). Out-of-order routing requires user-defined extensions outside the spec.

interconnect_role.INTERCON: WISHBONE module that physically interconnects MASTER and SLAVE interfaces.
interconnect_role.SYSCON: Drives the bus clock [CLK_O] and reset [RST_O].
interconnect_role.default_slave: Not explicitly mandated; recommended for completeness.

guaranteed: All beats of a burst presented to the same SLAVE in order; CYC_O held throughout.
Pipelined-mode: requests in order, ACKs in order.
Locked sequences ([LOCK_O]=1) are not interrupted by other MASTERs.
not_guaranteed: AXI-style out-of-order completion (Wishbone has none in B4).

memory_vs_peripheral_regions.wishbone_memory_slave: Synchronous RAM/ROM model (Section 8.7 / FASM); supports SINGLE / BLOCK cycles and (if registered-feedback) burst cycles.
memory_vs_peripheral_regions.wishbone_peripheral_slave: I/O register block (e.g. Section 8.6 SLAVE I/O Port Examples — Simple 8-bit / 16-bit examples).
memory_vs_peripheral_regions.wishbone_bridge_slave: Other-bus bridge (e.g. WB-to-APB, WB-to-AHB, WB-to-PCI); may use [RTY_O] for temporary unavailability.
